Order 
This is the second application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. (483 of BNSS) for grant of bail relating to Crime No.66/2016 registered at Police Station Amayan, District Bhind (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 363, 365, 366, 366-A, 376-D of IPC and Section 5G read with Section 6 of POCSO Act.
This is a case of bail jump.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that earlier, the applicant was granted bail vide order dated 09.07.2018 passed in M.Cr.C. No.21692 of 2018.

Thereafter, at the stage of final arguments,
he remained absent on 12.10.2022, therefore, permanent arrest warrant was issued against him and in compliance of which he got arrested on 25.11.2024 and since then he is in custody.
The absence of present applicant-accused is bona fide.
Because he went outside for labour work, he could not appear before the court below.
It NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:603 2 MCRC-506-2025 is further submitted that applicant is in custody since 25.11.2024.
His further custodial interrogation is not required.
He is ready and willing to abide by all the terms and conditions which may be imposed by this Court.
The trial will take time to conclude.
On these grounds, he prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
Per contra, learned counsel for the State vehemently opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application Rahul Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/164589498/
1 is allowed, but with certain stringent condition and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac Only) with two solvent sureties of Rs.50,000/- each to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court.

7) The applicant shall appear before the concerned police Station once in every fortnight till conclusion of trial.
